profile.description: Al Madina Insurance Company SAOG provides insurance products and services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers personal insurance, including motor, travel, domestic helper, pleasure craft, home, life, individual critical illness, individual credit life, and livestock insurance products. It also provides corporate insurance, such as property and commercial, engineering, liability, marine, general accident, group credit life, employee benefits, and motor fleet insurance products. In addition, it offers takaful, an Islamic co-operative insurance; retakaful; and reinsurance products. Al Madina Insurance Company SAOG was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman.
